plan.question: On current adopted startup-global-concurrency main, what SQL/cache tradeoff does 16->8MiB cause on a >16MiB table?

plan.delta: same binary validated two-argv selector, 16M->8M size and size_max only; canonical main runtime unchanged
metrics: prepare and whole process wall/CPU including warmup+final pristine
plan.exit: fixed5 pairs; all outliers retained; report tradeoff; no automatic sample extension, adoption or CI
